scope: Durable publication of existing six/twelve-cell synthetic development evidence only; no test or simulation rerun during publication

attempts.failure_evidence_scope: The initial failure summary and exact executed source bytes were saved immediately. The summary retains the failing expression, check counts, boundary events, and tool-output chunk reference; it is not represented as the full raw checker stdout.
attempts.explanation: Checker incorrectly required subtraction of two differently accumulated floating-point h states to equal exactly 2.0. Their recorded values on the corrected check are 5.882368317456969 and 3.882368317456969, difference 1.9999999999999996. All initial inert/nonempty-inactive parity checks and delayed event identities passed before that assertion.
attempts.earlier_import_only_failures: Three source derivation errors failed closed before synthetic execution: delivery anchor had zero matches, short return anchor had three matches, and method indentation caused compile refusal. Their descriptions are retained in the failure summary; no executed model states existed for those import attempts.

attempts.changes: Checker compares each branch against its exact ordered decay/addition recurrence, without subtracting already-rounded state totals; source also rejects illegal negative last-spike sentinel values at restore. No edge-delivery logic was changed to make the failed subtraction assertion pass.
attempts.source_recovery: Both exact intermediate source byte streams were reconstructed by removing only the subsequent observation-expansion method/test block. Their SHA256 values match the source hashes inside the already-retained attempt-2 checker output.

attempts.changes: Parent-requested observation-only replace_selected_indices API and focused invariance/rejection checks added. Every original selected column, all other outputs, input membership, full neural state and pending queue retain parity.

limits: The full-network audit gate and live no-suppression saved-checkpoint prefix probe are separate evidence.
These synthetic checks neither execute nor establish the effect of any active full-network intervention.
Caller must archive intervention specification and source RNG boundaries separately from the unchanged checkpoint schema.
